predictions.articleTitle: Oriente Petrolero vs Independiente Petrolero Prediction & Match Analysis: Defensive Bans Test Home Edge

spf.comment: A 2:1 home win leads behind Oriente's 1.68 goals per game, while bans for Francisco López and Dico Roca make a 1:1 draw a live second script that a solo win call would overlook.

btts.comment: Oriente's 81.4% scoring projection meets Independiente's 71.1% scoring projection against an improvised home back four (57.8% BTTS baseline).

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Oriente's superior firepower and recent H2H results, while 1:1 covers Independiente's compact counter threat.

goals.comment: Three goals align with the 2:1 primary anchor and 2.92 lambda, with two goals covering the 1:1 draw branch.

bqc.comment: Both recent league H2Hs were tied at halftime before Oriente pushed through late, with Draw-Draw covering a sustained 1:1 stalemate.
